layouts.name: Long Beach Street Circuit
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The independently named Long Beach circuit relation contains one complete closed source-node cycle. The course follows Shoreline Drive, the Aquarium fountain section, convention-centre return and final hairpin, matching the published 11-turn INDYCAR circuit. The mapped road centreline measures 3258.4 m versus the catalogue 3169 m and operator 1.968 miles; temporary race barriers and exact historical racing alignment remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3258.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
